observations: Photo 0, 1: two wooden table tops (one blue-grey laminate, one wood-grain laminate) mounted on black cast-iron treadle-sewing-machine style legs, standing outdoors on bare ground/pavement.

Photo 2, 3: close-ups of the table tops showing a rectangular cutout in the middle where a sewing-machine head would normally sit; the cutout is empty in both, showing bare ground or a dark liner beneath, not a machine.
Cast-iron treadle mechanism, flywheel, and a metal foot-pedal grille are visible under each table in photos 2 and 3, consistent with old Singer-style treadle bases.
No sewing machine head, needle plate, bobbin, motor housing, wiring, or electric motor is visible in any of the 4 photos.
No accessories (bobbins, spools, manual, belt, etc.) are shown in any photo.
No brand name, logo, or model plate is legible on the iron legs or table tops in any photo.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'SESHMAK TECH' overlay the images; otherwise no identifying marks.
Items are shown outdoors on rough ground/pavement, suggesting storage outside, not indoors.
Seller's new message is text only, reasserting prior claims; no new photo or video was provided.

identity.kind: treadle sewing-machine table/legs (cast-iron base with wooden top), no machine head included

claims.evidence: No brand plate, logo, or engraving is visible on the legs or table in any of the 4 photos; seller's verbal reassurance adds no visual proof.

claims.claim: the motor runs smooth / "I tested it myself yesterday"
claims.evidence: Photos 0-3 still show only an empty cutout where a machine head/motor would sit; no motor or machine head is present in any photo, and no new photo was sent to support the claim.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories, bobbins, belts, or manual are visible in any of the 4 photos; seller's reply did not include a photo of them.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history cannot be seen in a photo; no machine head is even present to assess, and no new evidence was given.

risks.risk: No actual sewing machine head/motor is included despite being described as a working, tested machine with a smooth motor.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the sewing machine head sitting in the table cutout, with the motor and wiring visible, or a video of it running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as bare treadle table/legs only, with no machine head, i.e. not a functioning sewing machine.

risks.risk: Condition and rust level of the cast-iron treadle mechanism and flywheel cannot be fully judged from outdoor photos with shadows and dirt.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the flywheel, pedal linkage, and iron joints in good light, plus a short clip of the treadle being pedaled.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/rusted working condition, not restored.

risks.risk: Wooden table tops show laminate/veneer finish of unknown durability; water or ground exposure outdoors may have caused warping or damage.
risks.proof: Photo of the underside of the table top and any edges for swelling, warping, or delamination.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically worn, standard condition laminate top.

risks.risk: Claimed accessories and manual are not shown, so their existence and completeness remain unverifiable despite verbal assurance.
risks.proof: Photo of the accessories (bobbins, belt, manual) laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as sold without accessories or manual.

proof_requests: Photo showing the actual sewing machine head mounted in the table cutout, if one is included.
Photo of the claimed accessories and original manual laid out.
Close-up, well-lit photo of any brand/model plate on the iron legs.
Short video of the treadle pedal and flywheel in motion, or of the motor running, to support 'tested it myself' and 'motor runs smooth'.
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video does not change what the photos show: bare table tops on treadle legs with an empty cutout, no visible machine head, motor, or accessories, so the item must still be priced at its worst-case condition as a sewing machine table/legs only.
